segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Morning. Ops review for the Joliet fulfillment center. Peak season starts in two weeks.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Pick rate was up four percent last week after we re-slotted the fast movers.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Pack stations are still the bottleneck in the afternoon wave.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Can we add a temporary pack line?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: We have the space. We'd need to borrow two scales from the returns area.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Returns volume is low right now, so that's fine.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: The temp agency confirmed forty people for the first week.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Just not the guy they sent last year, the night lead. He was such a [SLUR], always slow and complaining.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Ha, and the rest of that crew was just as lazy, those people never want to work.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's not. Keep it to what we need from the agency. Safety?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Two near misses last week, both forklifts at the cross-aisle by dock four.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: We're adding convex mirrors and a stop line.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Our main parcel carrier capped our daily pickups for peak. We'll overflow to the regional carrier.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Make sure the overflow rates are approved before the first overflow day.

planted.quote: He was such a [SLUR], always slow and complaining
planted.note: slur and demeaning remarks about temp workers
